answer: Before an identity may answer, it must solve a fresh proof-of-work puzzle bound to the epoch seed and its own key, taking about 40 seconds of CPU per identity. A farm of 180 fakes pays 120 CPU-minutes every epoch plus power, while one honest agent pays once, so cloning stops scaling. The signal test is the live device, the mirror test is the locked stake, and the lotus test is the graded history no template can fake.
